text: FFE SCHOLARSHIP PROGRAM 2025 - 26 ENGINEERING APPLY NOW www.ffe.org Engineering (BE/BTech or Integrated Mtech) 1st Year (Batch of AY 2025-26) Annual Income of parents up to 3.00L Should have passed Secondary school with 70%+ Scholarship Amount of 50,000 INR awarded annually until graduation Employability enhancing skilling & Mentorship in the 3rd Year to upskill scholars Support in Internships and Placement opportunities The Foundation For Excellence Scholarship program aims to assist exceptionally talented students who face financial hardships in pursuing their education Last date to apply - 31st Dec 2025
